What you need to know
Tick each one you know.
Squares: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100 are 12 to 102.
Cubes: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216 are 13 to 63. 1 and 64 are both squares and cubes.
Prime factors: in a perfect cube every prime comes in groups of three: 216 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 3.
Last digits: the last digit of a square or cube depends only on the last digit of the number.
